avis.texte: I have used this product along with the gel cream and the eye brightener for several years and I love them. The feel is so light and refreshing which I really appreciate living in Florida. I'm in my 70's and you can imagine what I look like and feel like some days when I'm getting ready. It perks my skin up and feels so good. I smooth it on and wait about 2 minutes for it to soak in and then put my makeup on. It goes a long way since very little is needed. I always make sure to buy it before I run out.

So I got a bottle of this in a subscription box almost 2 years ago and have since bought 2 more. This serum plumps my aging skin and brightens it so that all my discolouration evens out. My pores are smaller too. I love it
This is Panax Ginseng. Its not the same as actual ginseng. There are 3 types, not panax.
Love this product. Great smell and love what it dies to my skin. It's is light weight, moisturizing, gives you a glow. Great it you want to go makeup free.

I keep reordering this product because I love the lightness of it on my skin along with the tingling sensation of waking it up. I do use it all over my face including the sensitive parts of my eye lids and under eye area because it also has a nice tightening effect when it dries that makes your eyes feel "accounted for" if that makes sense. :)

I wanted to try something new to see if there is something better than what I already use. Origin was my go to brand for a lot of skin care items since early 2000s. I don't know what has happened, but a lot of the great products were either discontinued or changed in formula. Some of the newer products just don't deliver, like this one. I found it neither brightening nor retexturing/smoothing. In fact, I found it leaving my skin dehydrated and blotchy. I also found it difficult to apply as it has a sticky texture. I normally try to not leave 1-star/2-star reviews. I try to find a least one really good redeeming quality so I can give it three stars, but there is nothing in this product to find positive. I am not giving it one star because I am in a good mood, and I don't think it didn't outright damage my skin (it's recoverable with my previous product). I waited till I finished the product before leaving this review because it takes a few months before one starts to see results from a skin care product. I am so glad this is finished and I don't plan on repurchasing.

Love adding this serum to my skincare routine! It smells absolutely amazing and gives the skin an instant glow / radiant appearance. One pump is enough for the entire face and the formula is very spreadable. I think I'm on my third bottle already and I will continue to purchase this product in the future.
I have a pretty decent routine. I got a sample and tried it, and I was like Kevin mccallister in home alone. nope so many others that won't burn your face off

The only reason I purchased this moisturizer is because Origins discontinued the product that I had been using for years (Dr. Andrew Weil's Mega Bright Dark Spot Correcting Serum). This product is a very poor substitute for what they've decided to take away from me. I gave this lotion three chances. I was only able to actually keep it on my face once, since the second two times it stung my face so much that I had to wipe it off and use something else. The first time I used it, I was seriously unimpressed. It's more watery and less luxurious than the Mega Bright. It did not make my skin feel soft or hydrated. Instead, my skin felt papery and dull. Where is this "glow" that I was promised? Not to be found in this bottle. If Origins doesn't bring back the Mega Bright, I will find a new skincare company.

I've used this for about 3 months and my acne-prone super sensitive skin has brightened and cleared up so much! Ran out about 2 weeks ago and I can already see how dry and bumpy my skin is starting to look. Just purchased another bottle. I'll make sure to never run out again.
This serum is going to be a staple in my daily skincare routine. My skin is so happy since I've been using this serum and with maturing skin, it's perfection!

Purchased for the reviews, packaging, and because this product claimed to smooth the skin. Unfortunately, this product made my pores look bigger and my skin feel less tight, issues that I've never dealt with before while using other products. Anything this serum claims to do can be achieved with lower-cost products. I will keep using it since I've already wasted the money, but I wouldn't purchase it again. I use it alongside the Origins cleanser, which I could also do without.

I love this serum. The smell is light, and it fades quickly. It gives a nice, elementary hydration and also makes my daytime moisturizer work even better. I use one pump on days that I shower and 2 pumps on days that I don't.
Probably the best vitamin c product I have ever used if not my favorite all time skin product. Such a bummer its so expensive. But it is great does everything it claims.
This serum left my face with a perfect dewey glow. It's perfect under makeup or on a bare face.
Loved the smell, the absorption, and ease of application. This gives a slight cooling effect!
This is the best vitamin C for sensitive skin. It helps brighten my face
The smell is amazing! The serum makes my face glow! I use it when I don't have time for makeup, and it is worth every cent!

avis.titre: I will buy the product again
avis.texte: My skin is sensitive to all serum I have ever used. But. This serum was the best no Irritation no burning my face. So far my sunburns has started fading. I Love this serum. Thank you DR Andrew. W.

I have very dry, sensitive skin with occasional breakouts. Affer using this serum for about 6 months and my skin has never looked better. It has cleared my dark spots, brightened my skin and prevents breakouts as I barely have pimples anymore. Would recommend to anyone looking for brighter, glowy skin.

So glad I selected this product for my Ipsy bag and did NOT read the negative reviews first like I normally do or I would have not selected it. I really like this product and will probably continue to purchase it in the future. As promised , it truly brightens my skin. My daughter noticed about 1 and a half weeks in. She asked what foundation I was using and I wasn't using any foundation, just serum and moisturizer. Now that's saying something folks. Might just be my skin, I'm 69 years old and have been a beach girl my entire life so if anything makes my skin glow I'm using it. For the record, I even use it around my entire eye area- shoot me - it works and doesn't bother my eyes one bit!

I was so excited to use this product an after a week of applying it I noticed a lot of acne an some cystic acne an knew it had to be from this product so please be aware that if you have sensitive skin don't buy because it's been over a year that my skin has looked this bad it's awful

I've used this product for years and have always loved it. It has multiple ingredients that usually only come in single serums; hyaluronic acid, vitamin C, caffeine, and plant oils to calm the skin. Meaning you don't have to have a complex regimen if you use this. My face is always hydrated, smooth, and glowing when I use this product. It also helps with some of the fine lines around my eyes. I forgot how wonderful it was till I switched to the Ordinary because someone recommended it. Sure The Ordinary was cheaper but I had to buy several bottles of serum to match what this one bottle can do. Also my skin was not near as brilliant and the serum would flake off with other products. When I switched back to Orgins Ginzing serum, I immediately remembered why I love it so much. The results are immediate. Also it doesn't flake off under other products because it absorbs very well. Everyone's skin is different but this is my favorite product and I will never abandone it again. Sometimes you have to lose something to realize how great it is, I guess.

I've been using origins products more religiously lately because I haven't had a negative experience yet. I experimented with this first to see if it works well, I use it twice a day now (as part of my morning and night routine), it definitely revitalizes my skin. I apply two pumps each time and lock it in with my regular moisturizer as well. I use it before I apply my makeup on as well as part of my pre-makeup routine.

I had an allergic reaction with red itchy face with bumps. I used it once but initially I thought it must be with the food I ate or something. It took several days to clear with topical steroid. After a week or two, I used it again to try but I had itchy face and have red elevated bump, like a map; and I took Benadryl. Now for sure, I know it was from this serum. There's something in this product that makes me itchy. I have been using origin products for at least 8 yrs now with no reaction except at this time. I am throwing this, how I wish I can return and my money back. Please be cautious using this serum.
I love it I would recommend it I just wish it didn't cost so much ￼
I love this stuff. There is a noticeable glow with the first use

avis.titre: Left my skin bumpy and with breakouts
avis.texte: I do not recommend this product. After just one application, within a day I noticed that my face was bumpy and I had breakouts (Prior to using this, I had not had any breakouts in years). It took 10 days for my skin to return to normal with no bumps. I do not typically have sensitive skin but some ingredient in this product is not compatible with me.

I had gotten a sample of this and adored it so much I bought the full version. I have dry to normal skin and this product adds the perfect touch. It makes my face feel so fresh after application. So many clean (and vegan) ingredients such as vitamin C and hyaluronic acid that make the skin glow and evens skin texture after just a couple uses. Looks beautiful under nautral makeup as well! Smells incredible too, there are essential oils added so if you dont like fragrances/have sensitive skin be aware and do a patch test before applying to face. I have been using the serum for the past month and my slightly textured skin has evened out completely and I have gotten many compliments on my "glowing complexion"

Origins is probably my favorite skincare brand and I've used various products from the line for years; however, have never experienced something like this before. I noticed a slight tingling upon use which I read is normal. After this continued after a few days/week I couldn't take it anymore and stopped use altogether. Despite the fact I completely stopped using it, one spot of my face continued to grow more and more irritated and inflamed. It's been over a month now and I have an actual burn in that spot that will not go away! I'm using every remedy that I can research but nothing is working - I called the dermatologist but can't get in for another few months! I have reached out to Origins regarding this and am awaiting a response (I hope). I pray this doesn't leave permanent damage.

avis.titre: NOT a replacement for Original Skin Renewal with Willowherb
avis.texte: I was told to use this as a replacement for Original Skin Renewal Serum With Willowherb, which they discontinued. This isn't even close to similar and I now can't find any serum that helps with my oily skin like the one I used to use every single day for years. I used to use the Original Skin serum and my skin was instantly brighter and clear looking, while also mattifying. This Ginzing serum has caused my face to be super oily. I am very disappointed with this product and with Origins. I wish they wouldn't constantly discontinue our favorite products, it makes me never want to rely on Origins ever again, because as soon as I love something, they discontinue it. So disappointed.
Not at all irritating, helps moisturizer go on smoothly, smells wonderful. Did not seem to cause increased in pimples

I received a sample of this in an Ulta order. A tiny sample. So tiny I am not sure what the point is of providing a sample of that size. I am able to deduce nothing from a single use other than I didn't have an allergic reaction. I am in no way compelled to buy the product since I cannot tell if it does anything it all after one use. Manufacturing samples of that size is worthless and not earth-friendly at all.
This serum has a calming and soothing effect. Scent is pleasant. All time favorite for sure. I buy this again and again
i used it for about a week but it made my skin itchy in certain spots and made me break out a little, it does not work for my sensitive skin, to much perfume also

avis.titre: I love the Ginzing serum and eye cream!!
avis.texte: I love the Ginzing serum and eye cream products. My skin has never looked better and I am 60 years old. My complexion is smooth, firm and glowing since using this product.

avis.titre: Must have for my big pores
avis.texte: I love this, it really helps with uneven skin tone, pores and texture on skin. Don't use right after exfoliating though.

I love this product. It was the first vitamin c serum I've used, and I love it! The ingredients are nice, and I love how it feels on my skin. I have very sensitive skin, so I was scared to use serums like this. However, I'm glad that I was wrong. My skin instantly looks glowy and smoothes over the pores in my skin. The blurring of pores does not last all day, but if you were to use this under makeup, it would work great with any pore-filling primer. I use about 2 pumps for my entire face, while bringing some of the product down to my neck. I've already repurchased this product since I use it everyday! Definitely a staple in my morning skincare routine.

avis.titre: Used couple of bottle and bough the max qty at promotion
avis.texte: Love this serum. It help me on facial skin and long term scape issue after try few other origin product and other brands. I am sticking to this.

avis.titre: You need this. I will always use this.
avis.texte: This is a one of those products once you use it you'll think why is the entire skin care community not recommending it for everyone? It absorbs properly, it keeps your skin clear, it makes it soft and absolutely luminescent without sparkles/oily/slimy nonsense. Truly a fabulous find and you will not regret getting it. Thanks origins!

Love how this feels like a water serum on my face, absorbs so fast and non-sticky!! Smells delicious and doesn't make me break out. I'm obsessed. My coworkers have even commented on how clear and glow-y my skin is looking!

This stuff works wonders. First time buying Origins, and I'm impressed. I noticed more results when I started using it over night, as well as in the morning. I don't really wear makeup anymore because it makes me so glowy I don't want to cover it with foundation. Im 30, I have oily skin, and live in a hot climate, this absorbs quickly, and doesn't make me feel oily at all and my skin looks better than it did when i was 23.
Really wanted to like this, I like the ginzing line. Clearly not a good fit for me. Caused significant breakouts all over my face.
This serum is so lovely! Feels and looks bright on my skin! Has a nice tingle too! Live the ginger!

You definitely will get a natural glow from this serum. First usage did cause some tingling and sloughing but after several times using, I did notice a big difference. Old acne scars totally faded and no further tingling. My glow looks like I have makeup on. I get compliments on my complexion. All thanks to origins. Love you.
I use it every night and pair with a nice moisturizer and it makes my SKIN GLOW
This serum makes my face feel so soft, especially in the morning after p.m. use. Skin is also less congested and pores appear smaller.

After only a few days of using this in the morning before moisturizer, my skin became irritated, red and flaky. I do not usually have sensitive skin, but this product did it to me. Will not purchase again.
I love the consistency of this serum! I put in under my moisturizer and make up and skin looks so healthy!

avis.titre: No change in pores, irritated my skin
avis.texte: I have combination skin that can be a little sensitive, but is not overly sensitive. That said, this product made the skin around my mouth and chin embarrassingly flakey, itchy and red. This reaction did not happen immediately, rather after a month of using it. I would apply it every morning as part of my normal routine and these skin changes gradually occurred until it dawned on me that this serum was making it worse. As soon as I stopped using it and applied Plantscriptions moisturizer instead, my skin was soothed. I saw no change at all in the large pores on my nose and am frustrated at the claim that 91% of women saw a change in their pores. I find that very hard to believe.

I have delicate skin and super dry. After I wash my face and use toner, I let dry and apply the ginZing. I let that sit for a few minutes and apply my moisturizer. It definitely adds glow and no dullness. I have noticed that if I have a little zit I pop during my monthly time, it does sting for a little

I really wanted to love this product. First week of use, it made my skin feeling smooth and soft. Second week, acne and breaking out started. Gave it another week hoping my skin is just adjusting but my face broke out really bad. I've never had this many acne before.
I was very disappointed in this product. Made my face burn and my skin dry and flaky. Would not recommend this product.
This product made my skin breakout so mad and itchy whenever i sweat. It made my skin very dry i stopped using it after 1 week of having irritation

i never leave reviews but this actually really makes me glow, i love it so much! i don't have sensitive skin though, so i cant say anything about the other reviews, but this stuff really works for me and i have super oily skin!
The product arrived with a lot of dirt and even some cat/dog hairs around the pump.

I have sensitive skin and this broke me out terribly, and dried out my skin. Thought maybe It was just because I started using a new product and my skin needed to get use to it but nope. after a month of dryness and new breakouts each week I decided to stop. now my skin is finally getting clearer and less dry.

Started applying this after washing my face with the Origins foaming cleanser and before using the Origins GinZing ultra hydrating moisturizer. I've noticed pretty intense angry red flare ups on my face, like the skin is irritated. On a whim I looked at the reviews for it and saw others had the same problem, which was validating. People with sensitive skin may want to avoid this.

I tried this serum for about 2 weeks. Initially, I loved it but it caused my entire face to erupt in breakouts. Upon further research, they use too much fragrance and essential oils which can be very irritating to the skin. I will stick to my Eminence Organics for clean skincare. Terrible customer service as well so very difficult to actually reach a representative, still have not heard back from one.

avis.titre: It convinced a friend I was coming out of my depression
avis.texte: I'm not, but apparently this made me glow in a way that made it look like I had my life together. I didn't have the heart to tell her it was just skincare lol. Any time I use it, I get compliments on how my skin looks and I often pair it with the Ginzing eye cream. I personally think it smells really nice, but I will admit that it smells stronger than the typical Origins product (just smells like orange/citrus, nothing bad). I'll probably buy the full size when I finish my samples, and I encourage anyone to try it out if given the opportunity. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin so I tend not to use too much product on my skin daily, however I've never had a bad reaction with this. I use it maybe once or twice a week.

I bought this for myself after saving for it for a while, and to be honest I'm so disappointed. I can't use it mostly because the smell is so strong and well not good at all. And after doing some research I found out how damaging essential oils are for your skin, and Origin products are drowning in them. I really don't get why you use so much fragrance especially when they can be damaging. Maybe if you lost the essential oils I would start buying more of your products but for now, I won´t
Pilled under my sunscreen. Smells strong. Super cute packaging.

I mirror the sentiments from many of the other reviews. I have been using Origins products for over 10 years and love the products, but for whatever reason, when using this product, my skin broke out and got very dry and flaky. I love all the other Ginzing peoducts.
I don't usually leave reviews but this leaves my skin glowing. I tried my friends and knew I had to buy it even though it's a little pricey.

I really wanted to continue to love this product. But! I was breaking out! I had read previous reviews about this issues and hoped it wouldn't happen to me. But process of elimination and I just stopped using it after 4 months. It's been about two weeks and my face has almost gone back to normal. I noticed results within a week. Now, I am 42 and have had acne back in the day but not to this extent recently. However, I did like the way it felt on my face! It wasn't greasy and it did give me a glow along with shrinking my pores which really drew me to the product in the first place. Overall good product but I can no longer use it. Oh well.

This serum is worth every dime! I had pneumonia a few weeks ago and my complexion looked dull. I purchased this serum along with glow boosting moisturizer. I have used it every night for two weeks. My skin has a natural radiant glow now. This product is fantastic!

avis.titre: This item gave me rashes on my neck.
avis.texte: I liked Ginzing Cleanser, so I wanted to try this item. Both my mom and I had rashes after using this one, and I threw it away.

avis.titre: I now am experiencing a breakout
avis.texte: Over the last few days I been experiencing a breakout. I religiously use Origin products and have only had one bad experience with a toner and now this. I had to do some trouble shooting and the cause has to be this product. I am usually a creature of habit and keep the same morning and night routine. I am so upset. The reason I am loyal to Origin products is because it keeps my skin breakout free

I have been using the ginzing moisturizer exclusively for my face for nearly 10 years! I love it and recommend it to everyone! I was excited to try this new serum for all the awesome ingredients but it causes me to break out :/ I keep trying it hoping it is just an adjustment period, but it's been over a month and my skin is not happy with me.... (I normally have very clear skin and rarely get pimples- a few times a year, so I know it's this product and not some other thing)
This serum is absolutely gorgeous! It has delivered on pore reduction, glow and texture. I highly recommend this product!

I bought Into the Glow last November. I love the way this has evened out my skin tone, smoothed out my skin, and improved the overall condition of my skin. I will continue to use this product forever!

avis.titre: I am not sure I would buy again
avis.texte: I have used the product for about a month and it has dried out my skin so much. I am peeling which it says that is expected in the beginning but it has not gotten better. I use the perfect world moisturizer and do not see a difference. I expect more from this product.

This is my favorite product in my morning routine. Not only does it give my skin a lovely glow, but my face feels so incredibly clean and fresh after I use it. I was skeptical because the price tag is a little heftier than I'll usually buy, but it is 100% worth it. I'll buy this product again and again!

avis.titre: It didnt really do what it said
avis.texte: I really believed in this product and thought that this was gonna help my skin but it did the oposite. My skin actually got worse over the period i used it. And I am so sad because I usually love Origins...

I recently started using this. I have always used MB vitamin C serum and have loved it, but is been a decade of use and feel I needed something different. I use it at night, and upon waking up, my skin looks refreshed and glowy. My skin is combo/mostly oily during summer.
My experience with this product is bad, it caused the breakout on my face, I have only used it for several times, i had to stop and switched to another brand.

Wanted to love it, and actually do for my nose, but generally I'm just terrified to use it anywhere else! Caused major irritation and what looks like burns on my skin almost everywhere but my nose. Still bothering me in places now 4 days later. However; my nose pores have legit disappeared almost overnight. Just wish I had known how strong this was before I used it AM and PM when it first arrived.

I love the fragrance of the serum first off. Second, it's very light weight and so far not pore clogging, and last it melts into the skin without sitting above surface. I definitely recommend this serum especially for my women of color! Thanks Origins and to the representative who got my order sent directly to me the second time around!

avis.titre: I will continue to buy back this product
avis.texte: I use it in the morning and evening, after lotion, after a month or so, I find my skin more transparent and white. The oil situation has also been relieved!
I received a sample of this product and really liked it. I have very sensitive skin an it didn't get irritated and my skin looks brighter with less sun marks. Try it out!

I really wanted to love this. It feels so good when you initially put it on, it wakes you up a bunch and feels very clean! Unfortunately it's been giving me strange clogged pores on my neck and chin - I think it might be the essential oils. I don't doubt this works really well for most folks! But was a miss for me.
I use this daily before moisturizer. My skin is glowing and looks fresh even when I'm tired.
I really wanted to like this product but it made my skin more dry than usual. Tried for a number of weeks and decided it wasn't a good fit for my skin.
I love the lightness and how this feels on my skin as well as the pleasant odor. Of course I also love and have the whole Ginzing line.

avis.titre: I want to rate this so much higher
avis.texte: I'll start by saying it's one of the best serums on the market; it absorbs quickly, feels great, actually works... But my issue comes down to the scent. At first there's delightful, fresh citrus notes, and then, SICKLY MENTHOL. (Some people on here seem to like it, but it makes me wretch.) I'm guessing someone decided to add it to the recipe for "a cooling effect" but it's so unnecessary and in my opinion smells terrible, and it's ON MY FACE. It makes me not want to use a product I otherwise Love. Could I get specially made versions that are the same formula but without the menthol? I think about taking it back almost everyday. I would recommend it to someone, but with a sensory warning attached. If not for this, I'd rate it five stars.

avis.titre: I don't care for this product at all.
avis.texte: I ordered this for myself over the holiday's thinking that it could do what it actually says, brighten and glow. While it smells lovely, it feels very tacky when applied. When I use this in conjunction with the Ginzing daily moisturizer, it literly gums up like paste when I apply my foundation over it. I'm a long standing Origins customer and love several productions, but not this one.

I bought this serum in the hopes that I would feel like I have that glow and bright/radiant skin that so many people wrote about, however, after about month of using it, I'm unsure if it's really doing much for my skin. I do like that the serum doesn't leave my face oily and the scent is very refreshing, but other than that I don't know...I really want to love it but I am unsure.

I purchased this product while looking for a moisturizer. I have been using this product since the Covid shut down. I was inside most of the time without natural sunlight. I love this product!!!!In a month, I was staring at my face and touching it because it looked beautiful, even toned, healthy and felt so soft. The product is light, the smell is divine, and you only need a small amount. I am 51 and you would NEVER guess my age. It's been 7 months that I have been using this product and it's definitely a staple of mine. I just ran out, but will purchase again....and again. On my Covid Care list.
I have tried a few serums in the past and thought they were okay....but I used this and my face literally glowed! It smoothed my face and made it so soft!
This product was just ok at first after a week of use my skin broke out and was also really dry at the same time. I will never use this product again!

I'm coming from Kiehl's. Purchased this serum as one of my first Origins products to try it out. When I put this on after cleansing my face, it gave me an amazingly pleasant cooling sensation with a very nice citrusy smell. It did not leave any oily feels or anything. Some of the Kiehl's serums made for day time use definitely left my skin feeling oily, which I didn't like. I have combination skin. My moisturizer went onto this serum very nicely. I also like the fact that it comes in an actual glass bottle, not some cheap plastic bottle. This serum definitely has the WOW factor. Will continue to use it!

In my 15 years using Origins I've never been a big fan of Ginzing line. Decided to try this new brightening serum. I'm still on my 1st jar.. so it's an ok day serum. It does provide a little moisture and a 'wake up' feeling maybe. I don't really have dark spots so I can't speak of how well it treats them. I don't hate it but I don't love it either. Would I purchase it again? Yea, maybe, sure; but I still prefer Plantscription anti-aging serum which is the best on this planet.
This is my new favorite serum! After one use my skin was glowing! It just soaks in and leaves my skin looking fresh!

avis.titre: The best product in the world
avis.texte: After dealing with dry and overall bad skin, this product totally transformed my face. My face has had a tremendous decrease in breakouts in just a week. I love love LOVE this product. Would recommend this to everyone!!!!
Decreases my pore size , has smoothed my skin and plumps it up

I use AM & PM and its gentle enough on my sensitive skin. I've always used Origins products but with this serum I have had a noticeable difference within only a few days of use. My face doesn't feel dry mid day, and I wake up more even toned plus overall much less dull. I would highly recommend!

I love this product! I started using the GinZing line a couple of months ago and was so excited to add this to my routine. This product smells great and a little goes a long way. I use it in the morning and at night (before my moisturizer) and it gives me such a beautiful glow from within. It doesn't make me look greasy but leaves me with a beautiful youthful glow all day long, even without makeup. The only thing I would suggest is if you have sensitive skin this may be too much for you (or maybe use once daily rather than twice). It definitely makes my skin more sensitive, but not in a bad way, I just have to remember to moisturize and use sunscreen.

I've been really pleased with this product! I use it at night only, but even with just one time a day use, I've noticed a difference in my skin. It has been quite a bit smoother and noticeably more hydrated, which contributes to overall brighter looking skin. I have slightly dry skin around my nose and it's been that way for years regardless of what products I use. The only time it went away is when I used a face scrub, followed by a hydrating mask, and even then, it only disappeared for a day or two. However, since using this product, I no longer have the dry patches of skin at all, and I haven't needed to use a face scrub in general because my skin is so smooth. I'm attributing this to the AHA/BHA complex and green coffee seed extract. This product has overall been really awesome!

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: With the Origins GinZing Into the Glow Brightening Serum a little goes a long way. Just a small drop was enough for my whole face. I apply after washing my face 2 times a day and noticed a difference in my skin texture very quickly. After lots of sun exposure over the last few months my skin was very dry and bumpy. The vitamin C helps brighten and Hyaluronic Acid helped give my face the hydration it needed. Also love that it has coffee extract which helps get rid of dead skin cells. Overall love this product and plan to continue using it.

I have only been using this product for 24 hours but I have already observed a huge improvement in my skin. My skin is plump and pores are minimal. I decided to skip makeup today which I rarely do and I have caught a few glimpses of myself in the mirror today and I am impressed! I have never felt this type of confidence with a bare face. Yesterday, however, I wore makeup and it wasn't a problem to have it underneath it at all. If anything my skin looked more smoother and it cling to my foundation well. I'm excited to wake up and put it on again!
